title: The Cheapest Cities to Live in South Florida
igCaption:
Typical rent, August 2026 (Zillow): Oakland Park $2,151, Margate $2,134, Greenacres $2,128, Lauderdale Lakes $2,065, Lauderhill $1,878. Miami is $3,008. Palm Beach is $7,432.

What do you pay?

Sources: Zillow Observed Rent Index (August 2026)

#rent #broward #miami #southflorida

scenes.text: If you're broke, these are the cheapest cities in South Florida you can move to, starting with Oakland Park.
Number five, Oakland Park, in Broward. Typical rent is two thousand one hundred fifty-one dollars a month. That's up ninety percent since twenty fifteen, when it was eleven hundred thirty-five.
scenes.caption: #5, Oakland Park, in Broward. Typical rent is $2,151 a month. That's up 90% since 2015, when it was $1,135.

scenes.text: Number four, Margate. Two thousand one hundred thirty-four a month, and it's a little lower than a year ago, when it was two thousand one hundred forty-eight.
scenes.caption: #4, Margate. $2,134 a month, and it's a little lower than a year ago, when it was $2,148.
scenes.sub: Broward · down from a year ago

scenes.text: Number three is in Palm Beach County. Greenacres, at two thousand one hundred twenty-eight dollars. Ten minutes east, the town of Palm Beach averages seven thousand four hundred thirty-two.
scenes.caption: #3 is in Palm Beach County. Greenacres, at $2,128. Ten minutes east, the town of Palm Beach averages $7,432.

scenes.text: Number two, Lauderdale Lakes, at two thousand sixty-five a month, up from sixteen hundred forty-three about five years ago.
scenes.caption: #2, Lauderdale Lakes, at $2,065 a month, up from $1,643 about five years ago.

scenes.text: And number one, right next door, Lauderhill. Typical rent is one thousand eight hundred seventy-eight dollars, the lowest of any city in South Florida's Zillow data, and it actually dropped from nineteen thirty-six last year. The city of Miami is at three thousand and eight.
scenes.caption: And #1, right next door, Lauderhill. Typical rent is $1,878, the lowest of any city in South Florida's Zillow data, and it actually dropped from $1,936 last year. The city of Miami is at $3,008.

scenes.text: What do you pay for rent where you live?
